q=quotes.copy()
q['name']=q.vendor.map(vendors.set_index('vendor')['name'])
e=q[(q.comparable)&(q.cleared_questionnaire)&(~q.not_quoted)]
r=e.loc[e.groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.idxmin()].copy()
r['cheapest_any']=r.rm_code.map(q[q.comparable].groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.min())
r['Line']=r.rm_code;r['Vendor']=r.name;r['Cost/kg']=r.cost_inr_per_spec_kg.round(0);r['Cheapest overall']=r.cheapest_any.round(0)
r['Spend INR']=r.spend_inr.round(0)
r['Risk flags']=r.risk_flags.apply(len)
r['Status']=r['Risk flags'].apply(lambda x:'Proceed' if x==0 else 'Hold')
result=r[['Line','Vendor','Cost/kg','Cheapest overall','Spend INR','Risk flags','Status']]
print(r.spend_inr.sum(),(r['Risk flags']>0).sum(),(r.cost_inr_per_spec_kg>r.cheapest_any).sum())
